Mission: Hudson Technologies is committed to providing products and services that reduce greenhouse refrigerant emissions, increase energy efficiency, and promote sustainability to encourage understanding and ensure future generations inherit a healthy planet.
Vision: Improving environmental quality and promoting a healthier planet through the sustainable recovery and reuse of natural resources.
We offer one of the largest refrigerant selections in the country from CFC’s to HFO’s as well as specialty refrigerant gases and everything in between
Providing on-site services that minimize environmental impact by optimizing refrigerant management, reducing emissions, and extending the life of HVACR systems

Facilitating sustainable refrigerant management solutions that focus on recovery, reclamation, and reuse, helping customers reduce emissions, comply with regulations, and support environmental stewardship

Hear directly from customers who rely on Hudson Technologies for refrigerant solutions, reclamation services, and industry expertise.
Great to work with. Easy to use. Very helpful. Highly recommended.

Working with Hudson is always very easy! They pay us for our reclaimed gases, after years of paying other distributors to take our reclaimed gases Hudson is great! Aaron has helped me navigate several issues, always very responsive! Thanks!

I absolutely LOVE being a partner with Hudson Technologies! Their customer service is the Best BY FAR. I never have to wonder if we are going to be taken care of, they are always very fast at getting back to me, and I am able to make my customers happy because of Mary John and her team over at Hudson. So grateful for them and what they do!
Easy to use. Great customer service. It is wonderful to get paid! I have nothing but good things to say about this company. So glad that Lennox has decided to partner with them!
Great service and they always hit the mark! Thanks for your efforts.
Hudson has been a great resource for us here at Jacobs and Rhodes to handle refrigerant, service is simple and communication is awesome!
It was an easy experience turning in our old recovery bottles. We even got paid for some of what we turned in. Better than any local companies.
A great program for companies to track the amount of refrigerant being reclaimed, exchanging bottles and being paid to do so brings so much value to this service.

With an HVAC companion we have always struggled with returning refrigerant to distributors. High cost plus getting questionable replacement containers. With Hudson Technologies are return process has become a breeze. We get paid for the refrigerant we return, we get just about new containers, and we don’t have to pay to get rid of it!! No shipping charges and a simple form to fill out online for pick ups. It couldn’t be any easier!
